_comment: Pilot seed list (task 22 / #144, architecture.md A38). Each entry is a
NewAssetInput body POSTed to /assets by deploy/seed-pilot.py — assets are
registered through the API (US-1), never written to the database. The file
lives in the repo (A38); its repository URLs never enter telemetry (the
seed script is a plain API client and emits no spans/metrics/logs).
The HUMAN supplies the exact repository URLs before the first registration
(issue #144 constraint). Replace the REPLACE_ME entries below with a few of
your own GitHub repositories, keep or adjust the OWASP Juice Shop entry, and
repositoryUrl must be exactly https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> (no .git, no
extra path); criticality is one of low|medium|high|critical.
VERIFY (A41): OWASP Juice Shop commits a supported package-lock.json. If it
does NOT (it may ship only a pnpm/yarn lock), drop the juice-shop entry and
use the juice-shop-fallback entry instead — an open-source repo pinned to
older versions with a committed package-lock.json, which yields findings.
Confirm on github.com, then delete whichever of the two you are not using.
